status: Bounded source critical/pierce proof; modern quantity behavior uses released primary and firsthand historical D2R report, with exact pinned executable/RNG acceptance still open.

historicalFirsthand.author: DarkMaster
historicalFirsthand.scope: Author reports own D2R play: mastery/Deadly Strike/oskill crits conserve and replenish at throw, empty-air throws qualify, pierced victims do not replenish again, ethereal weapons qualify. This is firsthand historical evidence, not a3.3.93847 instrumented capture.

established: The unchanged projectile helper always rolls generic Critical Strike first, even at zero chance, then nonzero Deadly Strike, then nonzero eligible weapon mastery. First success short-circuits. This differs from the ordinary melee helper order.

Creation calculates the critical flag once on damage data, then copies it as a boolean missile stat; impact reads that saved stat. Formula/collision/impact blocks are traced only, not fully compiled here.

Creation adds item and skill pierce and prerolls at most4 continuations. The unchanged loop is compiled for nonnegative chances; actual seed algorithm and owner-pierce seed remain explicit services. Existing native budget cap4 matches this bounded contract.
limits: Declared stat-layer, used-skill, item type and RNG services. Generic oskill Critical Strike remains unavailable in native gameplay; source isolation covers its branch without enabling it.

Modern conservation-roll ordering relative to critical/pierce, exact modern RNG algorithm, quantity-zero/ethereal destruction and full projectile snapshot/proc/client behavior remain separately unverified. One quantity recovery is supported by the historical reference convention, not independently instrumented here.
No modern executable is compiled; no claim of complete3.3.93847 equivalence.
